SYARIE LEGAL PROFESSION (FEDERAL TERRITORIES) ACT 2019

SYARIE LEGAL PROFESSION (FEDERAL TERRITORIES)
(FEES) RULES 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 92 of the Syarie Legal Profession
(Federal Territories) Act 2019 [Act 814], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Syarie Legal Profession
(Federal Territories) (Fees) Rules 2024.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 1 January 2025.

Fees and payment of fees
2. The fees prescribed in column ( 3) of the Schedule shall be paid to
the Chief Registrar for the matters specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

(1)
No.
(2)
Matter
(3)
Fees (RM)
1. Issuance of Certificate of Peguam Syarie 500.00
2. Application for Annual Practising Certificate 150.00
3. Application for an extract or a copy of the
Register of Peguam Syarie 100.00
4. Inspection of the Register of Practitioners 100.00

Transitional
3.  (1) Any application for an Annual Practising Certificate for the year of 2025
made before the coming into operation of these Rules  shall be deemed to be made
on 1 January 2025 under these Rules.

(2)  Any fee s due and payable  to the Chief Registrar  for any application
made under subrule (1)  before the coming into operation of these Rules shall be paid
from 1 January 2025.

Made 25 October 2024
[JAKIM.(R). BUU.600-1/1/9 Jld. 3; PN(PU2)764/JLD.3]

DATO' SETIA DR. HAJI MOHD NA'IM BIN HAJI MOKHTAR
